correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the vertex process to an exact scalar recurrence on incomplete nondeficient parts: before a part i activates it sees k-s_i+U active neighbors, so activation is equivalent to U>=s_i, and activation contributes u_i new vertices. Sorting by s_i yields a necessary and sufficient greedy criterion. Exhaustive replay through order 8 agrees with the literal process for every minimum-size subset and with the profile-count formula.

value.rationale: The exact optimum size was already known, but optimal interventions are not interchangeable: some optimum-cardinality seed distributions stall. The weighted parking criterion gives a complete structural description, a fast membership test after sorting part seed counts, and an exact count of all optimum seed sets. This is a natural refinement relevant to robustness and choice among minimum interventions, rather than a routine recomputation of the scalar optimum.
